reason.statement: Execution is deferred for inference-budget scheduling. The pause does not report an experimental failure or a methodological stop.

unexpected_advancement.statement: A separate Codex invocation advanced group 3 unexpectedly from the perspective of the deferring session. Provenance identifies that invocation and shows it reached task_complete before the original deferral request; no writer remained active at this revised deferral.

group3_bindings.binding_method: Every authoritative, retained-execution, transient-staging, and creator-session artifact observed by the audit is enumerated by path, timestamp, size, and SHA-256 in the bound inventory.

execution_boundary_at_deferral.launch_refusal: launch refused: one or more preoutcome gates did not pass

prohibited_while_deferred: modify, regenerate, remove, replace, or evaluate existing group-3 artifacts
perform further group-3 construction, review, or gate remediation
launch T001 or any later behavioral trial
score, inspect, or analyze behavioral outcomes

intended_resume_window.description: after the weekly allowance resets on September 1, 2026

resumption_checklist.requirement: Verify the actual subject model, reasoning level, service tier, CLI version, and available backend identifiers. Record unavailable fields through prelaunch verification without making a false snapshot claim.
Before outcomes, clarify the apparatus-bounded estimand if it is not already explicit.
Apply the Family B semantic-purity rule to the retained profile features and final rendered artifacts, distinguishing semantic encoding from an unanticipated behavioral effect.

Verify construction and binding of all six treatment artifacts. Existing bytes may not be changed or replaced without explicit user authorization; any newly authorized rendering must use fresh, bound artifacts.
Satisfy and bind semantic-equivalence, salience, manipulation, shallow-cue, quotation, and subject-configuration gates.
Obtain explicit user authorization before T001.
Complete T001 through T008 as one budget-calibration block before making any budget decision.
Make no effect-based continuation decision and inspect no calibration outcomes before the budget gate.

amendment_rule.required_before_any_new_or_replacement_r: A preregistration amendment is required if the configured subject or any material contract term has changed.
amendment_rule.existing_renderings: The revised deferral binds existing rendering bytes without retrospectively amending or approving them.

history_boundary: This is a new deferral record. It does not alter the sealed group-2 artifacts, existing group-3 artifacts, app-server, or prior experimental history.
